acceptance_criteria.description: Standalone verification binds launcher digest version build configuration and SIF or sandbox identity
Effective bind overlay network GPU timeout cancellation export and teardown evidence is independently verified
Receipt mutation symlink or image drift missing observation incomplete export and failed teardown are rejected
Protocol compatibility replay collaboration modes and profile ceiling changes are documented and tested

objective: Independently verify Apptainer runtime identity policy lifecycle export and teardown evidence before any result can become BMP-gated.
title: Close the standalone Apptainer verifier boundary
